reviews.review: Admittedly, this has a Left 4 Dead feel, but it is so much better! The cool 60s vibe and unique artistic approach to an alien invasion is addicting. The maps are just long enough. Great weapon variety and upgrade rolls. This is going to be a sleeper hit. I wish there could be more story behind the characters, but everything else about the game and mission is entertaining. AFK mode is legit too and I can't believe this wasn't invented sooner. Totally great idea for you or if someone else falls off. I also like that AI takes over if someone drops out so you aren't left hanging. Everything about this was thoughtful!

It's Left 4 Dead in space, just not as good. The vast majority of the weapons sound weak, the shooting isn't satisfying, enemies sometimes ragdoll almost standing up so you're not sure if they're dead.

You've got equivalents to L4D's tank, spitter, smoker, and they work. What doesn't is the Flasher, a special whose gimmick is just that he emits a bright light that dims your entire screen before you even see him. He doesn't pose a danger other than to make your game look worse.

Anyway this game is 99% shooting and that aspect feels worse in every way than L4D, so I can't recommend it over that. If that improves I'll gladly come back to it.
super awesome idea here, feels fresh, mechs are solid, looking forward to more.

Edit: After 1.0 launch, the game doesn't really improved in its gameplay aspect. The game runs much better, so I can say that it's well optimized, my fps dropped only a few times during a horde or flasher. The core issues are still the weapons, the maps and the UI and the AI.

The maps are bad at this point, all of them are empty with huge areas. All maps are boring and short, only the first map feels fun, but that's all. The maps are filled with random props without any reason why they are there and so on.

The weapons are boring, only a few of them are fun to use, but the sound and the impact you should feel when shoot with a weapon are missing. It feels like playing with NERF guns. Not fun.

The UI could be acceptable, if the game is in early access, and you will know that they will change it. However, here this UI is the final, which is questionable for me at least. It's simplistic, but it looks like an Unreal Engine base asset. It's working, but it looks awful.

The AI is a joke. One of the worst AI I've ever met. The bots are stupid, always positioning around you even though you're shooting something (so you can't avoid to shoot them), they are waiting around 3-4 seconds to help you when you're grabbed or gooed, they activate the matter compiler even though you're playing on intenser difficulty (that means it triggers a horde by activating it), they are using medkits on you the same time, so 2 kits will be used etc. The enemy AI is also stupid, easy to trick them. The enemy AI spawn feels weird and makes the flow boring.

The characters are off, I can't really connect with them, they are boring, but this is the smallest issue with the game.

As a summary, I can't recommend this game in it's current state.  They should work on fixing these things and making the gameplay fun, because at this point it is not. I wish the developers the best to make this game better, the potential is still there and it can be a good game, but it really needs polishing and more work to be done.

I was surprised to learn this had been out for a year. I thought it was new and that they hadn't time to fix a lot of things. It's another beta that you have to pay for, lol. They keep adding "new" stuff but not fixing the appalling gameplay. They need to stop all the falling deaths. It's a real pisser when you can't even see where you're stepping cos there's so many flashing lights and aliens right in yer face. I bought it on sale, about £8, but it isn't even worth that.
